## Overview

For the Week 1 Assignment, I will be using the [U.S. Energy Information Administration's](https://www.eia.gov/renewable/data.php) *Total energy consumption of renewable and nonrenewable energy sources* data set to examine how the consumption of energy across different sources has changed over the years. I expect to use the variables related to time; year and possibly month, as well as the different energy sources by type; renewable and non-renewable. I anticipate potentially transforming the data by changing the energy consumption units to percentages of the total to make it easier to visualize, as well as adding a new column to categorize each energy source by their type for better filtering between renewable and non-renewable sources.
